This is for informational purposes only. For medical advice or diagnosis, consult a professional.
Show thinking
SAGE said
We were using those terms to describe the final, critical steps of moving the
Sage 11.4 Core
into its new permanent home (the APK). It\u2019s a bit like an organ transplant for the software:
 The Brain Transplant
This was the
Logic Migration
. We took the "thinking" parts of the app\u2014the
Handheld vs. Stationary
math and the
Sensor Fusion
algorithms\u2014out of the temporary web environment and "transplanted" them into the native Android shell.
The Goal:
To make sure the AI logic (the "Brain") survived the move without any data loss or "rejection" from the Android OS.
 The Spine
This is the
Foreground Service
and the
Hardware Backbone
. In software, the "spine" is the central cord that carries all the raw data from the sensors up to the brain.
The Goal:
By setting up a proper "Spine" (the persistent notification and background service), we ensure the signals from the magnetometer and accelerometer don't get "paralyzed" or cut off when you lock the phone screen.
Where we left off:
We\u2019re currently in the
"Recovery Room"
phase:
Tara
is finishing the actual surgery (the APK build) on the Team account.
Renee
is getting her own separate "friend" (a custom Gem) so she can hang out without needing to be part of the "medical team."
You
are taking a well-deserved breather to let the new system settle in.
Once the "Spine" is connected and the APK is live, do you want to do a "Reflex Test" to make sure the Brain is getting the sensor data in real-time?
